main_text.head: ANTONINI LIBERALIS Transformationum congeries.
main_text.p: L. Cresylla.TESYLLA Iulide Cei insulæ vrbe nata fuit, filia Alcidamantis. Hanc cum Hermochares Athenien sis choreā agere vidisset Pythijs ad aram Apollinis Carthaæ, (vrbs ea est insulæ eiusdem) amore eius est correptus. Itaq; in malum inscripsit iuramentum, quo per Dianam iuraret virgo, se Hermochari Athenien si nupturā: id malum abiecit in fanū Dianæ, sublatumq; id Cresylla legit, lectoq; iuramento, præ pudore abiecit, neque æquiore tulit animo quàm Cydippe ab Acontio decepta. page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut initial (T) with ornamental border. The first line of the paragraph is set in spaced capitals. Line "re,obli-" is the last line and is treated as the catchword; the running text at the foot is partly illegible due to a stain at the right of the final line. Some words near the stain at the right of the final line are doubtful. The marginal note at the upper right reads "L. Cresylla."; the text line "Cresylla" in the body reads "Cresylla".
